name: Space Engineers
description: Volumetric space engineering sandbox. Windows dedicated server installed via SteamCMD (anonymous).
notes: -console runs headless without the GUI; all world/session settings live in instance\SpaceEngineers-Dedicated.cfg (created on first run; you can generate one with the GUI tool on a desktop machine and upload it). Worlds are stored in the instance folder, so panel backups include them. Requires .NET Framework 4.8 on the host.
